This book contains %s recorded chapter(s).

Module sources add chapters to this same manual. Select Contents to jump directly to a recorded section.
book.totem.manual.section:
%s

book.totem.manual.getting_started.title: Totem Starter Guide
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.1:
WELCOME

This Totem Manual grows with you. Each installed Totem module can record its own chapter directly into this same book.
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.2:
DISCOVER

Craft a module's first block. Its advancement tells you which block can record that module's chapter next.
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.3:
RECORD

Hold this Totem Manual and use it on a module's manual source to append that chapter. A plain book can start a new Totem Manual when needed.
